offering_description.value: Limbach helps building owners and facilities managers upgrade and maintain mission-critical mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and controls systems. It designs, prefabricates, installs, manages, and maintains these systems.

quotes.quote: Limbach is a building systems solutions firm with expertise in the design, prefabrication, installation, management, and maintenance of heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls systems.

Limbach Holdings, Inc. is a leading building systems solutions firm. We partner with building owners and facilities managers to revitalize and maintain mission-critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems—ensuring buildings are always ready to perform when it matters most.
